scope: Public request screening only; candidate tasks are development-only after review
ranking: Ascending sha256(seed + NUL + dataset_revision + NUL + kind + NUL + identifier); kind repo for repository, task for task ID
rules: Commit the selection rule and candidate IDs before reading their task text
No gold, tests, HARD flags, patch size, or model scores in ranking
Two tasks from six repositories bounds review cost; preserve four repositories outside this review
Record all selected tasks including unsuitable and uncertain cases; expand only under a new plan
Multiple mentioned subsystems alone do not prove coupled work or need for reorganization
Public descriptions can include prescribed interfaces and detailed fixes; record this limitation
Review of public statements does not adopt a task for the main experiment or guarantee runnable images
